title: migronaut configuration
description: Configuration for migronaut.config.json. Options that hold live instances (hooks, logger, mongoose, client, clientOptions) are only available in a .ts/.js config.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor completion and validation

lockCollection.description: Collection used for the concurrency lock

lockTTLSeconds.description: Seconds before a lock is considered stale and reclaimable

strict.description: Abort (instead of warn) when an applied file's checksum no longer matches

useTransaction.description: Wrap every migration in a transaction. Requires a replica set or sharded cluster

createExtension.description: File type `migronaut create` generates by default

sequential.description: Use 0001-style sequential numbering instead of timestamps

templatePath.description: Path to a custom migration template file

environment.description: Value stamped on changelog records. Defaults to NODE_ENV, then 'production'

onLockLost.description: What to do when the lock is lost mid-run

envFile.description: The .env file to load, or false to load none

ensureIndexes.description: Create the changelog indexes on first connect

timeoutMs.description: Abort the run when a single migration exceeds this many milliseconds

reloadMigrations.description: Bypass the ESM module cache when loading migrations (long-lived processes)
